runs.t: Helping Black adults across LA make genuine friendships through outdoor adventures, culture, wellness and service. Most members come solo.

We started in 2023 with four people and a trail map. Every month we do one hike, one service day and one thing that has nothing to do with either. Most people show up by themselves the first time and leave with three numbers in their phone. No fitness level required, we wait at the top.
